scope: Root analytical refinement after inspecting the conservative compact-support tail bounds, before executing this refined bound. No spectrum or physical parameter is fitted.
method: Signed Birman-Schwinger operator S G0 S sign(V), S=abs(V)^(1/2). Kernel domination by the massless radial Green function implies norm<=Wmax/[ell(ell+1)], Wmax=sup r²||V(r)||. Its HS squared is bounded by 2 Irad3/[(2ell+1)(2ell+3)(2ell-1)]. Apply the same n>=3 logarithm bound.
profile_test: Bound Wmax on the original cubic-spline cells via padded Bernstein convex-hull ranges and a symmetric-matrix midpoint/radius bound, including all four real species. Verify conservative rounded Wmax=64 on 0..20, 0..25 and 0..50. This encloses the numerical spline, not an interval-certified exact BVP solution.
UV_bound: Retain the previously verified Vmax=2,I2=1800 frequency-tail bound at all angular momenta. Angular bound applies only below the frequency cutoff, avoiding overlap.
calculation: Sum through ell=100000, then bound the remaining decreasing ell^-4 series analytically. Reject the refinement if a spline enclosure exceeds its supplied rounded bound.
